Beauty clinic analytics

Beauty clinic analytics and wellness clinic reporting for stronger retention

Data Fort helps beauty and wellness clinics understand rebooking, no-shows, service revenue, staff capacity, customer retention analysis, and monthly business performance. The reporting is designed for clinic owners, managers, and staff who need clear insight without spending hours in booking exports and spreadsheets.

Pain points

  • Booking systems show appointments, but not always retention and rebooking patterns clearly.
  • No-shows, cancellations, and staff utilization affect revenue but are hard to review monthly.
  • Service revenue, add-ons, packages, and client segments are spread across reports.
  • Owners need a better way to see which services and staff schedules drive growth.

Sample metrics

  • Rebooking rate, no-show rate, cancellation rate, and client retention.
  • Revenue by service, package, staff member, time slot, or client type.
  • First-visit to second-visit conversion and lapsed client patterns.
  • Staff capacity, utilization, repeat clients, and service mix.

Decisions enabled

  • Which services need stronger follow-up or rebooking prompts.
  • Which appointment times, staff schedules, or service mixes create capacity pressure.
  • Which client groups are most likely to return or lapse.
  • Which monthly wellness clinic reporting questions owners should review with the team.

Local fit

Reporting outcome

Know what keeps clients coming back
